scope: Existing five runtime entries only; photographs and Dailyshot prices are verified separately by the integrating agent.

sources.evidence: Distiller Notes and product ABV support 63.3%, predominantly sherry-seasoned American oak, violet/vanilla/peat nose, toffee/honey/nutmeg/citrus palate and spiced creme brulee finish.

entries.note: Wine.com lists the US 750 ml presentation. This source verifies the expression and notes, not the separate Korean 700 ml Dailyshot mapping.

sources.evidence: Edrington Sweden's 2021-11-11 release confirms 63.9%, no water added after maturation, European/American oak sherry casks plus some former bourbon casks.
Official Tasting Notes support rose/pear/coconut/peat nose; poached pear/almond cake/honey/salty liquorice palate; toasted oak/orchard fruit/pepper/anise finish.

entries.note: Edrington press release describes a local 350 ml presentation; Whisky International also confirms 700 ml. Do not copy its inconsistent separate 'virgin American oak' profile table: the producer confirms sherry-seasoned American oak.

sources.evidence: Producer confirms 64.1%, 700 ml, no dilution, more Orkney peated malt and first-fill sherry-seasoned American/European oak with refill casks. Listed nose, palate and finish agree with the current Korean summaries.

Press Release confirms 64.3%, no dilution/chill filtering, mainly first-fill European sherry oak with American sherry oak, bourbon, port and refill casks. Coconut/lemon/cedar/Turkish delight/peat nose, grapefruit/rosewater/oak/heather palate, spice/liquorice/floral peat finish agree with current summaries.

sources.evidence: Producer confirms 64.7%, 700 ml and no dilution. The Craft supports first-fill European sherry oak, PX, refill, bourbon and first-fill American sherry oak. The Flavour supports clove/bonfire nose, prune/liquorice/heather peat palate and spicy dried fruit/smoked oak finish.
